text: Great views of the city. Definitely spend the little extra to go to the very top.

While continuing my walk along Fifth Avenue, I looked up at the Empire State Building—what a magnificent sight! Seeing this iconic skyscraper in person made me pause and take it all in.
I admired it from street level, and even from below, it was impressive. A memorable highlight of my New York adventure!
Great! No wait, wonderful staff, and great views!

L'empire State Building fait parti des observatoires historiques de la ville de New York.
Il offre une vue à 360°C sur la ville en extérieur. Nous avons fait le choix de le faire de nuit afin d'observer la ville illuminé et cela est vraiment une belle expérience.
La vue est précédée d'une visite du musée de la construction de la tour et également aux différents films ou émissions qui ont été tourné ou s'inspirant de ce gratte ciel.
Fantastic place to visit breathtaking views
Nach Möglichkeit, unbedingt ein Eary Bird Ticket (um 8:30 Uhr) kaufen, ist zwar etwas teurer, aber es lohnt sich, keine Schlangen und keine Wartezeit.

Not worth the view at the observation deck and very very unfriendly / rude staff: the black camera man shouting at customers when they want to skip the photo line. He must be thinking he is the guardian of the building or the boss or what the hell?! He intentionally made us waiting even if we didn't want the photos! When we passed he just shout at us. Never experienced this kind of behaviour at other decks including one world and top of the rock!!! Very unfriendly!!!

I have been here twice, and miraculously both times I went, wildfire smoke made the air and view considerably hazy. I got the 86th and 102nd floor passes, which were a godsend considering the air quality. The service was excellent; the people working seemed happy to be there. The second time I went, they partnered with a ice cream and cannoli cart, which gave me and my partner something yo eat while I was up there. The price of admission is high, but it is definitely worth going, even if it is just once.
Fantastic
Every transition was smooth and staff was incredibly friendly. What a beautiful, historical experience.

It was a very good tourist attraction!  The views at night are amazing.  The staff is efficient and polished.

Museum auf dem Weg nach oben sehr empfehlenswert. Man kann auf einer Außenterrasse 360 Grad betrachten. Durch die Außenterrasse und die perfekte Lage inmitten Uptown der beste Ausblick der Stat. Gerade bei Dunkelheit.

Ohne Reservierung geht nichts. Aber die Aussicht ist natürlich ein Knüller. Vor zehn Jahren war es oben etwas romantischer. Mittlerweile ist es mehr kommerziell ausgerichtet.
Best experienced

It's fun to do the tourist thing and go to the Empire State Building. If it fits in your budget it's a great way to view a lot of the city and the surrounding area. 86 floor observation deck is great, it's outdoors, and has 360 view. 102 floor observation can be worth the view because less people go there so you have less crowds and you get a bit of a higher viewpoint. It's not outdoors but the 360 view from up there is floor to ceiling through the windows.

It was nice to have options on pricing as well as experience.  We chose the 87th & 101st floors self-tour. I think it was $81pp. We went approx 230p on a beautiful Saturday in October and we could see amazing views in all directions. The video displays about early building were fun, informative and really well done. After a entertaining elevator ride up a wonderful black gentleman was wiping each window as he circled the floor and it made a nice difference, TY sir! Walking outside on the 86th was neat, I was glad for my sweater. Then 101st is almost all glass & metal. And iconic building I'm glad to have experienced.
Lugar que guarda su majestuosidad a través del tiempo y se actualiza en el tipo de instrumentos y tecnología para mostrarte su historia.

This is the Empire State Building! One of the most recognized buildings in the entire world (at one time, the tallest building in the world). Go there... spend the money for the 102nd observation deck.
Una experiencia que no se puede pasar por alto
The authentic and majestic Empire State Building

Friday night sunset, tickets for 4:30pm, no lines.  This was actually my 3rd visit.  I’ve never seen a line here, although you can tell that they are set up to handle some large crowds.  I wouldn’t bother paying for the express VIP pass to bypass the lines, because if the lines don’t exist on a Friday afternoon for the sunset, do they ever exist?  10/10, hope that helps!

Went up to the 102nd floor for sunset. A good experience all round - the exhibits first then the 86th floor for viewing outside before the small 102nd to watch the sunset. On the way out my 12 year old also found 30th Anniversary Pokemon cards in their giftshop (no idea why they had them!) so a very successful trip all round. No queuing, even though it was sunset on a Friday, express tickets definitely wouldn't have been worth it.
